name: Ticket To The Other Side
source:
You're about to start your shift… during the dreaded Halloween night. Every minimum wage workers nightmare. The overly stuffed train with a bunch of weird individuals already sounds lovely enough, but you're very well aware that your boss won't allow you to cut any slack. You try to survive the night and pray that everyone paid for their ticket. But any corporate training couldn't prepare you for what's to come.

[From [url=https://rogueapplestudio.itch.io/ticket-to-the-other-side]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你即将开始今天的轮班……偏偏是在令人闻风丧胆的万圣节之夜。这简直是每一个拿最低时薪的打工人的终极噩梦。挤得水泄不通的车厢里塞满了形形色色的怪人，光听起来就已经够受的了；更何况你心知肚明，老板绝对不会容许你有半点偷懒懈怠。你拼命想要熬过这个夜晚，在心里祈祷车上每个人都老老实实买了票。然而，任何入职培训都无法让你对即将降临的一切做好准备。

[摘自[url=https://rogueapplestudio.itch.io/ticket-to-the-other-side]itch.io[/url]]
